business_problem: Augusta National Golf Club needed to keep the Masters digital experience engaging in real time because millions of patrons expect live context and storytelling from decades of tournament and shot data without any lag or loss of polish.
solution_summary: Augusta National Golf Club and IBM evolved the Masters digital platform into an AI-driven insight engine that translates proprietary sports data into live fan experiences. The implementation combines more than 50 years of tournament video archives with over a decade of shot-level event data, then assigns 49 specialized AI agents and 9 digital workers to focused tasks such as shot analysis, historical comparison, and storytelling during tournament play. Those agentic services continuously turn raw play data into contextual narratives that are delivered through the Masters app, giving patrons richer insight into each moment without interrupting the viewing experience. Architecturally, the solution functions as a real-time analytics and serving layer built on proprietary content: historical assets and live shot data feed the agents, orchestration distributes tasks across digital workers, and the app becomes the final delivery surface. The result is a differentiated data product that strengthens loyalty by making the tournament's unique history actionable in the moment.

business_outcome: The Masters strengthened fan engagement, preserved its premium brand experience, and created a scalable digital platform that can keep turning proprietary sports data into differentiated live storytelling.
